title: Achu Soup
description: Achu Soup is a Cameroon classic prepared with taro root, scotch bonnet pepper, beef tripe, ginger root. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. The traditional Cameroonian yellow achu soup often includes regional spices and cow skin; this uses a simpler palm-oil sauce and cooked tripe.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 40 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 14 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Simmer beef tripe separately in seasoned stock until very tender before serving with mashed taro and yellow palm-oil sauce.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
